acceptanceCriteria: The owner records a decision on the V1-0015 -> V1-0014 dependency edge, and the store reflects it (edge corrected, or the exception recorded).
V1-0014's milestone and priority are confirmed or changed by the owner.
Whether complete-manual should refuse or warn on an unsatisfied COMPLETED-obligation dependency is answered; if yes, a fixes ticket is filed with a reproduction.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session while counting the tickets left before 1.0 (corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202, corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360).

Observed: V1-0014 (Qualify independent proof producers and consumers; EXTERNAL, P0, milestone post-1-0) is OPEN. Its only dependent is V1-0015 (Ship a digest-pinned portable CI verifier; milestone v0-7), which carries a COMPLETED-obligation dependency on V1-0014 but was itself completed by complete-manual on 2026-09-23 (PR #75 and #88, decision 0356). So a COMPLETED ticket has an unsatisfied COMPLETED dependency. V1-0014 does not gate 1.0: V1-0020 and V1-0021 depend on V1-0015, which is already COMPLETED. A naive transitive walk from V1-0021 that traverses completed tickets reaches V1-0014 and misreports it as a 1.0 blocker.

Questions for the owner: (1) Is the V1-0015 -> V1-0014 edge inverted or obsolete (the portable verifier ships first, and independent qualification consumes it), so the edge should be removed or reversed? Note that set-dependencies is refused on COMPLETED tickets. (2) Is V1-0014 correctly post-1-0 with priority P0, or should it be re-prioritised? (3) Should complete-manual refuse, or at least warn, when a dependency with obligation COMPLETED is not COMPLETED? This is a suspected tooling gap, not a confirmed bug: the manual disposition may be intended to override.

Owner answer 2026-10-07 to questions 1 and 2: remove the edge; V1-0014 is not needed for 1.0 (it stays post-1-0). Done the same day: V1-0015 was reopened, its dependencies were set to none, and it was re-completed with its original evidence digest and reason plus a note (revision 5). Question 3 (should complete-manual refuse or warn on an unsatisfied COMPLETED-obligation dependency) remains open.

completion.reason: Owner answered all three questions on 2026-10-07 in the orchestrator session. (1) Remove the edge: V1-0015 was reopened, its dependencies set to none and re-completed with its original evidence (revision 5). (2) V1-0014 is not needed for 1.0 and stays post-1-0, unchanged. (3) complete-manual should warn (not refuse) on an unsatisfied COMPLETED-obligation dependency: filed as V1-0979 with a reproduction. No repository evidence file exists for an owner chat answer, so the evidence list is empty.

title: Owner question: V1-0015 completed with an unsatisfied dependency on open V1-0014 (post-1-0); fix the edge, and should complete-manual refuse?
